name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The code holds only an unimplemented-instruction marker, so the decoder stops at once and no logic is recovered. It is referenced from the audio device handler table.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no register or memory work of its own. It is referenced as a handler pointer in the audio device.

name: call_first_pointer_in_block
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in the first longword of the block passed in an address register, then returns.

name: advance_audio_request_queue
description: Decrements a count in the request block and, when the count reaches zero, either clears a field or unlinks the next queued request. It then passes control to a routine taken from the device base.

name: finish_audio_request_chain
description: Updates the request from its attached state, relinks it into a list when a pointer is present, and decrements its count, unlinking the next request at zero. It ends by calling a routine from the device base.

name: decrement_request_and_signal
description: Decrements a count in the request block and, when it reaches zero, unlinks the next queued entry or clears its pointer. It then calls the Exec Cause function and a routine from the device base.

name: store_audio_request_value
description: Sets the request's handler pointer to its own first field, then stores a value from the block into a device field with its top bit set. It calls a routine from the device base when a flag bit is set.

name: copy_request_fields_and_unlink
description: Copies two fields from the request into the device block, unlinks the request from its list when it has a link, and calls a routine from the device base.

name: clear_request_and_notify
description: Clears the request's link pointer, stores its handler address, and writes a field into the device block. It calls a routine from the device base when a flag bit is set.

name: dequeue_request_on_carry
description: When the carry flag is set, clears a count field in the request. Otherwise it takes the first entry from the request's list, unlinks it, and updates its fields, then writes a field into the device base and calls a routine from it.

name: dequeue_audio_request
description: Takes the first entry from the request's list and unlinks it, or clears the request pointer when the list is empty. It then writes a field into the device base and calls a routine from it.

name: call_routine_touching_custom_chip
description: Calls one other routine and returns. The decoder records a register access to the custom chip base in this routine.

name: call_routine_with_chip_base
description: Calls one other routine and returns, and the decoder records a register access to the custom chip base.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns with no other work. Its callers are entries in the program's pointer tables.

name: call_gap_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns; the bytes sit between known routines and decode as code.

name: clear_request_flag_and_call
description: Clears bit one of a flag byte in the request block, then calls a routine from the device base. It is reached from a pointer and from one other routine.

name: link_node_into_list
description: Inserts a node into a list by updating neighbouring pointers, then resets the node's own pointers so it heads an empty chain.

name: drain_list_with_interrupts_masked
description: Repeatedly removes the first entry from a linked list while interrupts are disabled, calling a routine from the device base for each entry. It writes the interrupt control register with the set bit clear to disable, and sets it again once the count drops to zero.

name: decrement_counter_and_enable_interrupts
description: Decrements a byte counter in the block and, when the value before the decrement was zero or negative, writes the interrupt control register with the enable bit set. The routine then returns.

name: initialize_audio_device_state
description: Sets up the audio device structure: it stores a value in its base, initialises three list heads, and fills sixteen channel blocks with interrupt vectors and DMA settings. It references the audio device name and calls the SetIntVector library function.

name: mark_request_and_enqueue
description: Sets a state byte in the request to minus two, then calls a routine with the request and a list header.

name: set_request_state_and_add_tail
description: Sets the request's state byte to minus two and calls the Exec AddTail routine through a stub to append it to a list.

name: requeue_or_release_request
description: If the request has no link or its flag bit is set, it passes the request to a routine. Otherwise it copies the forward link into the back-link field, sets the handler pointer, and updates a global word from a request field.

name: update_interrupt_status_word
description: Copies the forward link into the back-link field, sets the handler pointer, and writes status values into interrupt-related globals depending on a bit test. Writes with the top bit set enable interrupts.

name: walk_linked_request_nodes
description: Calls a routine on the given node and, when the node's link is set and not the head, calls the same routine on the linked node.

name: find_and_detach_request
description: Disables interrupts, scans a request list for the given node and, when found, removes it and marks it inactive before re-enabling interrupts. It returns one when the node was found and zero otherwise.

name: search_list_and_detach_node
description: Scans a list for the given node with interrupts disabled and, when the node is found, removes it and marks it inactive. It returns one on success and zero otherwise.

name: scan_list_and_detach_node
description: Scans a list for a node while interrupts are masked, marking the node inactive and calling a routine to remove it when found. It returns one on success and zero otherwise.

name: mark_all_requests_inactive
description: Walks a list and sets the state byte of every entry to minus two while interrupts are disabled, then calls a routine to finish the list.

name: mark_remaining_requests_inactive
description: Sets the state byte to minus two for each node in a list, then calls routines under interrupt masking and processes any remaining entry.

name: reset_request_flag_and_dispatch
description: Runs a sequence of list and queue routines with interrupts masked, clears bit one of a flags word in the block, and calls a further routine from the device base.

name: configure_audio_channel_control
description: Stores a fixed word in the channel structure, loads a per-channel value from a table into a global, and clears bit zero of a flags word. It writes the audio control register (ADKCON) and calls the SetIntVector library function.

name: copy_table_byte_and_call
description: Copies one byte from a table indexed by a register into the byte before a pointer, then calls a library function at a fixed offset from the library base.

name: initialize_empty_list_header
description: Initialises a list header in place: its first longword points just past itself, the next longword is cleared, and the last longword points back to the header.

name: call_exec_forbid
description: Calls the Exec library Forbid function through the library base stored in a global slot, then returns.

name: call_exec_free_memory
description: Calls the Exec library FreeMem function through the library base stored in a global slot, then returns.

name: increment_counter_clear_bit
description: Increments a 16-bit counter in a library structure and clears bit three of a flag byte in the same structure.

name: decrement_library_refcount
description: Decrements a 16-bit reference count in a library structure. When the count reaches zero and bit three of a flag byte is set, it calls a cleanup routine and returns its result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: release_or_defer_library_node
description: If the count is zero, unlinks the structure from its list and calls a library function to free it, returning the saved value. Otherwise it sets bit three of a flag byte and returns zero.

name: set_deferred_flag_return_zero
description: Sets bit three of a flag byte in a library structure and returns zero.

name: open_dos_library_or_alert
description: Stores two arguments in a library structure, calls a library function and saves its result. On a zero result it calls the Exec Alert function, otherwise it copies the stored values into globals; the text reference is dos.library.

name: copy_two_pointers_from_table

name: read_icon_image_sections

name: scan_table_for_equals_value

name: locate_key_value_separator

name: scan_chain_for_length

name: find_length_match_in_chain

name: verify_chain_length_match

name: search_chain_length_match

name: build_copy_name_string

name: parse_decimal_digits

name: parse_copy_number_text

name: convert_char_to_digit

name: allocate_icon_object_header

name: divide_by_divisor_bit_loop
description: Runs sixteen shift-and-subtract steps that divide a 32-bit dividend held in two registers by a divisor, leaving the quotient in the low half. It writes nothing to memory.

name: multiply_32_bit_integers

description: Calls a routine repeatedly while bit two of a status register is set.

name: check_status_high_bit
description: Calls a routine and then tests bit seven of a status word; both branches return, so the test has no effect on the result.

name: return_immediately
description: Contains no logic and returns at once.

name: format_translated_output
description: Copies characters from the source text into the output buffer, mapping control characters to spaces and stopping at a hash marker or a size limit. It calls routines for the table lookups and returns a status.

name: store_space_before_pointer
description: Writes a space character two bytes before the address held in an address register.

name: replace_listed_letters_with_digit
description: Scans a text buffer for characters that appear in a fixed table of letters and replaces each match with the character for the digit four, then stores the new end pointer.
